dcterms:description: The JHU FLuency-Extended GUG Corpus (JFLEG) contains essays written by a range of English learners with different first languages and proficiency levels, annotated with fluency and grammar edits.

dcterms:creator: Christopher Bryant
dcterms:description: The Cambridge English Write & Improve (W&I) corpus is a collection of texts written by learners of English of varying levels of proficiency, annotated for corrections by W&I annotators.

dcterms:creator: Sylviane Granger
